periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation tilted approximately 45 degrees downward toward the nasal midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ellipsoidal/oval geometry with a height approximately 1.5 times the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering where the patch narrows significantly at the inferior-medial point.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, wide U-shape curvature along the posterior boundary of the scapular band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Extensive thickness covering approximately 30% of the visible torso length at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation distance approximately equal to twice the width of an individual ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex apex on both visible ear structures.
